ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Michelangelo Buonarroti

code.originalText: Hand osteoarthritis and gout review at about seven months

text.paragraph: Hand osteoarthritis and gout review at about seven months. [S]

Mr. Buonarroti returns about seven months after his first visit and five weeks after his wellness visit. His hand pain stays about 3 of 10. He carves three to four hours most mornings with the splint and padded tools and writes his own letters again, if slowly. He takes acetaminophen 1 g on most days and the gel once or twice a day. He has had no gout flare, no urinary symptoms, and no falls. His DXA is booked for next week. [S]

S — Synthetic modern diagnosis confirmed by examination and radiographs. The joint pattern echoes the retrospective portrait-based interpretation (R, possible), which remains a hypothesis about the historical person; his documented difficulty writing is D.

S — Synthetic modern diagnosis; the portraits studied show only the left hand.
Chronic gout without tophi, in remission on allopurinol with serum urate at target
S — Synthetic modern diagnosis, crystal-proven years ago in the synthetic history. Gout in the historical person is a retrospective reading of period language (R, possible).
History of urinary stones, passed spontaneously years ago; stone-free on fluids and allopurinol
S — Synthetic modern entry linked to the urinary calculus documented in his own letters (D); the composition of his historical stones is not known.
Laceration of the left index finger from a slipped chisel, 2.5 cm, without tendon, nerve, or nail injury; repaired and healed
S — Synthetic injury at an unscheduled visit; weak pinch grip from thumb-base osteoarthritis let the chisel slip. It does not echo a documented injury.
